stages.title: STATE CAPACITY AS AN INTEGRATED ARCHITECTURE

pills.text: STATE CAPACITY AS AN INTEGRATED ARCHITECTURE
RULER-CENTRED AUTHORITY
APPOINTMENT, TRANSFER, PROMOTION AND JUDGEMENT
DIFFERENTIATED FINANCE, MILITARY, HOUSEHOLD AND GRANT FUNCTIONS
RANKS ELITE STATUS, REMUNERATION AND SERVICE OBLIGATION
MEASUREMENT, AVERAGES, RECORDS AND LOCAL MEDIATION FUND THE STATE
DAGH, CHEHRA, ACCOUNTS AND NEWS TEST PAPER CLAIMS
SUBSTANTIAL CAPACITY REMAINED PERSONAL, HIERARCHICAL AND UNEVEN.

OFFICES → differentiated finance, military, household and grant functions
MANSABDARI → ranks elite status, remuneration and service obligation

VERIFICATION → dagh, chehra, accounts and news test paper claims

stages.title: MANSABDARI: RANK, REMUNERATION AND OBLIGATION

pills.text: RANK, REMUNERATION AND OBLIGATION
GRADED IMPERIAL RANK, NOT ONE MILITARY HEADCOUNT
COURT POSITION AND PLACE IN THE SERVICE ELITE
CASH CALCULATION, OFTEN MET THROUGH A TRANSFERABLE JAGIR
CIVIL COMMAND AND CAVALRY OBLIGATION INSIDE ONE HIERARCHY
TURANI, IRANI, RAJPUT, INDIAN MUSLIM AND OTHER ELITES INTEGRATED
HIERARCHY CREATES COMPETITION AND REMAINS DEPENDENT ON IMPERIAL FAVOUR.

sequence: MANSAB → graded imperial rank, not one military headcount
STATUS → court position and place in the service elite
SALARY → cash calculation, often met through a transferable jagir
SERVICE → civil command and cavalry obligation inside one hierarchy
RECRUITMENT → Turani, Irani, Rajput, Indian Muslim and other elites integrated
